Head-sha: `6b63264b11937f6de45e78c72736defd42c9d648`

### ① Derived judgments

Diff read from GET /pulls/9840 (application/vnd.github.diff) and cross-checked against `git diff origin/main 6b63264b` in a shared scratch clone: 3 files, +240 −0, zero deletions. Every change to an accepted set or public surface, one line each:

1. `PercentFieldMetadata.scale?: number` added (packages/types/src/field-types.ts, the percent arm). WIDENS the published authoring face by exactly one optional key. Published: `packages/types/src/index.ts` at head names `PercentFieldMetadata,` in its export block (git grep exit 0, one hit); the emitted `dist/field-types.d.ts` (tsc -p tsconfig.json in the scratch tree, exit 0) carries the member with its docblock. The widening is real, not nominal: with the two lines ablated, `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exits 2 with TS2339 x2 and TS2353 "Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'scale' does not exist in type 'PercentFieldMetadata'"; at head it exits 0. `BaseFieldMetadata` has no index signature (grep for a `[key` member in its body: exit 1, none). Authorised: the card asks for it, the triage ruling grades it as writing an already-read key into the declaration, and the evidence-transfer comment instructs copying the number arm's form. RIGHT.
2. Docblock on `scale`, byte-identical to the number arm's. Neither widens nor narrows; documents the new member. Lit reading: grep -c 'Number of decimal places to display' on the head file = 2 (exit 0); after ablating only the percent arm = 1 (the number arm's copy survives, the control). Exactly what ruling comment 5726442790 directed. RIGHT.
3. `precision` on the percent arm: NOT narrowed, retired, deprecated or re-documented. The diff has no deletions; `precision?: number;` is present in the percent arm at head; the type-level pin `_PrecisionUntouched` asserts it is still the same shape as the number arm's. The fence holds. RIGHT.
4. No other arm touched. Census of all 38 `*FieldMetadata` arms at head: only Number (precision + scale), Currency (precision, no scale) and Percent (precision + scale) declare either member. Currency is unchanged. Neither widens nor narrows; correctly out of scope. RIGHT.
5. No runtime surface moved: `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, `packages/fields/src/widgets/PercentField.tsx`, `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` are not in the file list. Both dispatch fences on the render faces respected. RIGHT.
6. New test `packages/types/src/__tests__/percent-field-metadata-scale-9784.test.ts`: not a public surface. It does pin, by content, a file the dispatch fenced as read-only (`percentField\.scale\b` present and `percentField\.precision\b` absent in packages/fields/src/index.tsx). Reading only, no write; acceptable, coupling flagged in ③.
7. Changeset `.changeset/9784-percent-field-metadata-scale.md`: not a surface; judged in ②.

Nothing in the diff is unclaimed by the body: the three files, the two source lines, the docblock copy and the pin are all described, and the body's "I did not touch precision" is what the diff shows. Net: this PR widens what an author may write by one optional key, narrows nothing, changes no behaviour; that is precisely what the card and its two rulings authorise.

Premise still valid at review time: origin/main (177d3799f) is 3 commits past the merge-base 3ae740c4a; `git diff --stat 3ae740c4a origin/main -- packages/types/src/field-types.ts` is empty (exit 0), so main has not moved the touched file.

### ② Semver level

Declared: `'@object-ui/types': minor`. Frontmatter parses; `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` exit 0; `check-changeset-presence.mjs` exit 0 with one changeset declared; `check-changeset-fixed.mjs` exit 0; `check-pending-changeset-literals.mjs` exit 0.

Match with ①: an additive optional member on a published interface is a widening, which is minor, not patch. In this repo the fixed group forbids major (AGENTS.md 版本号策略, mechanised by the no-major gate), so minor is the highest level a widening can carry here. The changeset says which face moved, in those words: "the published authoring face of the percent field type", and states the excess-property fact that ① reproduced, plus "Nothing about how percent values render moves here", which the file list confirms. Its "copied verbatim from NumberFieldMetadata" claim is the 2-then-1 grep reading above. Its "I did not touch precision" clause matches the zero-deletion diff. No contradiction between level, prose and diff. ② passes.

Nit, not a contract defect: the changeset body is written in the first person ("I added", "I did not touch"). It is the only one of the 1684 pending changesets at head that is (git grep, 1 file), and changeset bodies publish verbatim into the CHANGELOG. A rewrite into the repo's impersonal voice would be welcome but is not required for this verdict.

### ③ Boundary flags

Measurements the body leans on, each reproduced from a `git archive` of the head sha with the workspace's installed dependencies linked in (spec 17.4.0, matching the lockfile pin at head):

- Lit control, same file and instrument: `git grep -n scale` on packages/types/src/field-types.ts reads 1 hit (line 409, number arm) at merge-base and at origin/main, 2 hits (409 and 431) at head; all three draws exit 0. Subject: grep -c scale inside the extracted percent-arm body = 0 with exit 1 at merge-base, 1 with exit 0 at head; the same extractor on the number arm at merge-base reads 1 with exit 0, so the zero is a reading. My first origin/main draw was void (the ref's slash broke my scratch filename); redrawn and reported above.
- Spec door, standalone node script outside the test file: percent + scale 2 accepted; percent + precision 10 accepted; both together accepted; scale 2.5 refused (invalid_type at scale); bogus key refused by name (unrecognized_keys listing it); second control, type number + scale 2 accepted. Descriptions read off the installed face: precision "Total digits (non-negative integer)", scale "Decimal places (non-negative integer)". So the claim that no fork is owed on `precision` rests on a measurement I reproduced, and the fence was honoured rather than sidestepped.
- Pin, both instruments, both states: vitest at head exit 0, 10 passed; ablated exit 1, 2 failed / 8 passed, failing exactly "PercentFieldMetadata declares scale" and the docblock-parity case with "expected undefined to be defined". tsc -p tsconfig.test.json at head exit 0; ablated exit 2 with the three errors quoted in ①. My first two vitest draws were void on my scaffold (root config loads apps/console, whose vite config needed a node_modules I had not linked); both redrawn and reported here. Ablated blob hash b043a3be4b equals main's blob, as the body states.

(c.type === 'currency' ? 2 : undefined)` through a local column type, useColumnSummary.ts lines 343, 401 and 468 through an inline column type and `(col as any).scale`. Every read reaches the member through an untyped or inline carrier, none through CurrencyFieldMetadata, and no runtime reading was taken. Out of #9784's scope and correctly left alone. ESCALATED to triage as a filing candidate with the implementer's dedupe words; not a defect of this PR.

Out-of-scope note 2 — no docblocks on the percent arm's precision, min, max. Re-documenting `precision` is fenced by the ruling; adding prose there would have been the very scope widening the fence forbids. Correct not to touch.

So `precision` is a live read on main today, which makes retiring it a behaviour change, not a declaration tidy-up: the fence is doubly justified.
